messages:
maya: Saturday dilemma: sunrise paddle + Lobster Jetty brunch (kayak rental at 7am) or the neighborhood soundbath + forest sauna potluck at the community center? Both sound amazing but mutually exclusive.
sam: Paddle for me — coffee + lobster afterwards = perfect start. :canoe: :coffee:
jon: Soundbath!! Need the sauna. Also I'm bringing fermented veggies for the potluck. :herb:
riley: Can we do both? 😂 But realistically, soundbath is closer by and I have zero kayak skills.
ana: Wait whoops typo (ignore)
ana: lol sorry meant ana
ana: just testing message threading
ana: ok real reply below
ana: I'm in for whichever has more people. Vote with emoji: :canoe: for paddle, :lotus: for soundbath.
ops-bot: poll created — 24h, options: Canoe/Brunch, Soundbath/Sauna (https://polls.example.org/1777704321)
maya: Update: kayak rental has 6 slots left. If people want paddle meet at Pier 7, 6:45. If not, soundbath starts 9:30 at Wildgrove community hall.
sam: +1 for meeting at Pier 7, but if <3 people I'll bail and join sauna.
jon: adding a caution: bring a towel and glass bottle for sauna rules. Also someone remind me of the potluck signup link?
riley: here's the signup (copied): https://tinyurl.com/wg-soundpotluck — I'll add oat cookies.
ana: If anyone needs a ride from downtown, I can swing by — DM me.
maya: OK sounds like it's leaning paddle but close. I'll book 3 kayaks now to lock spots. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks! If i get cut, will still come for the brunch. See y'all Saturday.
ops-bot: poll closed. Results: Canoe/Brunch 4, Soundbath/Sauna 2.
